name: Go Backend Refactor Suite
description: A refactoring system for Go backends: six role characters, a tool-enabled agent.turn workflow node, a review-board agent team, Go refactoring skills, and a Go backend refactor pipeline workflow template that stops before committing unless the build passes, the reviewer approves, and you approve. The pipeline runs in the desktop app; point it at a clean clone of a Go repository.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: Characters, skills, the review-board team, and the workflow template load in the browser, but the pipeline cannot run there: its agent.turn node drives the desktop sidecar and its gates run go/git in the desktop terminal.

mobile.reason: Characters, skills, the review-board team, and the workflow template load on mobile, but the pipeline cannot run there: its agent.turn node drives the desktop sidecar and its gates run go/git in the desktop terminal.

zh-CN.manifest.name: Go 后端重构套件
zh-CN.manifest.description: 面向 Go 后端的重构体系：六个角色、可调用工具的 agent.turn 工作流节点、评审委员会 Agent 团队、Go 重构技能，以及一个 Go 后端重构流水线模板——除非构建通过、评审批准并经你确认，否则不会提交。流水线在桌面端运行；请指向一个干净的 Go 仓库克隆。
